added: Failed chapter labels in Download Manager and a Retry download option for each failed chapter.
A Retry failed downloads action that appears when one or more chapters fail.
improved: Download progress remains visible alongside failure status, even when a provider could not return its page list.
Completed chapter folder and CBZ files receive non-destructive readability checks before indexing.
fixed: Existing empty or unreadable chapter files are no longer silently treated as completed downloads.
Finalized chapters must remain readable through Android storage before being marked downloaded.
